noun_definition: Suggestion triggering text refers to specific text inputs, such as ':pizza', that are intended to activate suggestion emojis within the app when sent in a message.
Sent message refers to the text that has been sent in the app, specifically the suggestion triggering text like ':pizza' that is copied and pasted into the compose box.
Suggestion emoji refers to an emoji that is triggered by specific text inputs, such as ':pizza', in the app's messaging system.
